lines.en: label kaorispecial35:
scene nightsky
I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone in hopes that she isn’t currently standing in the middle of the road and attempting to drown herself in rainwater.
lines.zh: 我在手机里点下 Kaori 的名字，希望她这会儿没有站在马路中间、试图把自己淹死在雨水里。

lines.en: That would be quite hard to do right now given that it isn’t raining, but seeing as literally nothing has ever made sense while I’ve been with her, I don’t want to say it’s {i}impossible.{/i}
lines.zh: 现在根本没下雨，这么做当然很难，但考虑到我和她在一起时从来没有任何一件事讲得通，我也不想说这{i}不可能{/i}。

lines.en: It’s always raining somewhere — just never around me.
lines.zh: 某个地方总在下雨 —— 只是从来不在我身边。

lines.en: That really tells you a lot, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 这真的很说明问题，对吧？

lines.en: : Paper!
: Well, that’s a new one.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这倒是新鲜。

lines.en: : Help to unfold!
lines.zh: : 帮忙展开！

lines.en: : By any chance, is your Japanese regressing? Because you’ve been doing pretty...{i}okay{/i} lately when you’re not completely zoned out and soaking wet.
lines.zh: : 该不会是你的日语在退步吧？因为你最近……还{i}挺不错{/i}的，只要别整个人神游、浑身湿透的话。

lines.en: : You lack the understanding, Friend! The thin, fragmented corpse of a fallen tree was attached to my entry block when I arrived at house tonight! I am worried of what secrets it contains!
lines.zh: : 你不懂，朋友！今晚我到家的时候，一片又薄又碎的倒树尸体贴在我的入口方块上！我好担心里面藏着什么秘密！

lines.en: : There was some sort of...paper taped to your door? It’s probably just an eviction notice or something. Have you been paying your rent?
lines.zh: : 有什么……纸贴在你门上？大概就是驱逐通知什么的吧。你房租交了吗？

lines.en: : I deliver a smaller tree-corpse to the groundwoman on the beginning day of every month! And a discount poster for the creaming as well! That can not be it!
lines.zh: : 每个月的头一天我都会把一张小一点的树尸交给地面女！还会附上一张奶油打折海报！不可能是那个！

lines.en: : Just open it up and find out.
lines.zh: : 打开看看不就知道了。

lines.en: : Are you sure that my safety is guaranteed?
lines.zh: : 你确定我的安全有保障吗？

lines.en: : Sure, why not.
lines.zh: : 当然，为什么不呢。

lines.en: : Then...unfold!
lines.zh: : 那么……展开！

lines.en: : Ah!
: Are you being evicted after all?
lines.zh: : 你还是被驱逐了吗？

lines.en: : No! It is something much less horrible than that!
lines.zh: : 不！是比那美好得多的事情！

lines.en: : It is a treasure map!
lines.zh: : 是一张藏宝图！

lines.en: : It’s {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 是{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Treasure! And directions on how to locate it!
lines.zh: : 宝藏！还有找到它的路线！

lines.en: : You must join me, Friend! Adventure is currently patient!
lines.zh: : 你一定要跟我来，朋友！冒险现在正耐心等着我们！

lines.en: : It’s like 9:00 PM. Do we really have to go on a treasure hunt {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 现在都晚上九点了。我们非得{i}现在{/i}就去寻宝吗？

lines.en: : Yes! I will see you at my cubic dwelling in the coming moments! I must prepare!
lines.zh: : 是的！我们马上就在我的方块住所见！我得准备一下！

lines.en: : Kaori-
lines.zh: : Kaori——

lines.en: scene black
What I didn’t know at the time of that phone call is just what “treasure” awaited us.
lines.zh: 那一通电话的时候，我还不知道等着我们的「宝藏」到底是什么。

lines.en: And how pressing the right button at the right time would ultimately change our lives.
lines.zh: 也不知道在正确的时间按下正确的按钮，最终会改变我们的人生。

lines.en: scene map1
But that’s enough shifting tenses for now.
lines.zh: 不过时态换来换去就到此为止吧。

lines.en: The story you’re more interested in is the one unfolding right before your very eyes.
lines.zh: 你更感兴趣的，是正在你眼前展开的那个故事。

lines.en: Like a map — or a guide on how to take a step forward without cutting your leg-hands on clear, malformed sand.
lines.zh: 就像一张地图 —— 或者一份指南，教你如何向前迈出一步，又不会在透明而畸形的沙子上割伤你的腿手。

lines.en: It matters not what the future holds, but how we get there and how many gashes we are able to avoid along the way.
lines.zh: 重要的不是未来会有什么，而是我们如何抵达那里，以及一路上能避开多少道伤口。

lines.en: In the coming hours, you will encounter something you do not understand.
lines.zh: 在接下来的几个小时里，你会遇到你无法理解的东西。

lines.en: But, contrary to the way things normally are, it’s something you won’t instinctively look away from.
lines.zh: 但与往常不同的是，这一次你不会本能地移开视线。

lines.en: I tell you this not as someone recollecting the past, but as someone experiencing the present right there with you.
lines.zh: 我告诉你这些，不是作为一个在回忆过去的人，而是作为一个和你一起经历此刻的人。

lines.en: Open your eyes.
lines.zh: 睁开眼睛。

lines.en: Hold out your arms.
lines.zh: 伸出双臂。

lines.en: And accept this gift from those who think you need it-
lines.zh: 然后收下这份来自那些认为你需要它的人的礼物——

lines.en: Even if you feel like you don’t.
lines.zh: 哪怕你觉得自己并不需要。

lines.en: : Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm...
lines.zh: : Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm……

lines.en: : Can I see-
lines.zh: : 我能看看——

lines.en: : I understand where we must go. But before we embark on our grand adventure, I must strengthen my cock.
lines.zh: : 我知道我们该去哪儿了。但在踏上这场大冒险之前，我得先强化我的鸡巴。

lines.en: : I am referring to my chicken cock.
lines.zh: : 我指的是我那只鸡的鸡巴。

lines.en: : Just “chicken” is fine. Where is he anyway?
lines.zh: : 直接说「鸡」就行。话说他在哪儿？

lines.en: scene map2
: What the actual fuck?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么鬼？

lines.en: : Kaori, this isn’t normal. That is not a chicken, it is a monster. And we will one day become its food.
lines.zh: : Kaori，这不正常。那不是一只鸡，那是一只怪物。而且我们总有一天会变成它的食物。

lines.en: : Impressive cock! And with an insatiable appetite!
lines.zh: : 好威猛的鸡巴！食欲还这么永不满足！

lines.en: : As his matriarch, I am very proud! He is the growing boy! And the guardian of the image box!
lines.zh: : 作为他的女族长，我非常骄傲！他是个正在长身体的男孩！还是影像盒的守护者！

lines.en: : What are you even feeding him that allowed him to grow to that size?
lines.zh: : 你到底喂了他什么，能让他长到这么大？

lines.en: scene map3
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : That is not an adequate answer to that question.
lines.zh: : 这可不是那个问题的合格答案。

lines.en: : I do not understand what the issue you appear to have is.
lines.zh: : 我不明白你看起来有什么问题。

lines.en: : That’s because your brain is broken, so I will help you. Your chicken has grown to an unreasonable size that makes me doubt it is even a chicken in the first place. He is {i}impossibly{/i} large.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你的脑子坏了，所以让我来帮你。你那只鸡长到了不合理的尺寸，大到让我怀疑它到底是不是鸡。它大得{i}不可思议{/i}。

lines.en: : Every pizza is a personal pizza if you try hard and believe in yourself.
lines.zh: : 只要你肯努力、肯相信自己，每一张披萨都是单人披萨。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
: The meaning of that word string is not one of cheese, but of hope.
lines.zh: : 那串词的意思与奶酪无关，而与希望有关。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
: Do not be jealous of my cock because it is so very large. Believe in yourself and find your own. Make your dreams no longer dreams, but {i}memories{/i} of a dream. That is what it means to live.
lines.zh: : 别因为我的鸡巴太大就嫉妒。相信你自己，去找到属于你的那根吧。让你的梦不再是梦，而是关于梦的{i}记忆{/i}。这就是活着的意义。

lines.en: : Kaori, he’s going to die at this rate.
lines.zh: : Kaori，再这样下去他会死的。

lines.en: scene map4
: Die?
: Reverse-live.
lines.zh: : 反向活着。

lines.en: : I know the meaning of the word, Friend. But John is healthier than he has ever been before on a diet of cornmeal and New Guinea flatworms. He will be fine.
lines.zh: : 我知道那个词是什么意思，朋友。可是 John 靠玉米粉和新几内亚扁虫维生，比以往任何时候都健康。他会没事的。

lines.en: : The cock only grows to the size of its apartment anyway. I am sure his growth spurt is nearing the reverse-beginning.
lines.zh: : 鸡巴反正也只会长到它住的地方那么大。我敢肯定他的猛长期已经接近反向开始了。

lines.en: : Kaori-
lines.zh: : Kaori——

lines.en: scene map5
: Enough of the cock-gobbling, Friend! We have treasure to discover and this map extends far beyond the reaches of my housing-cube!
lines.zh: : 别再吞鸡巴了，朋友！我们还有宝藏要找，而且这张图延伸到了我的住宅方块之外很远的地方！

lines.en: : Well...where are we going exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们到底要去哪儿？

lines.en: : To where the trees live.
lines.zh: : 去树住的地方。

lines.en: : The forest? Or...a treehouse? I feel like the answer could be either of those things.
lines.zh: : 森林？还是……树屋？我觉得答案可能是这两样中的任何一个。

lines.en: : The answer could be many things! But my treasure-senses are strong in terms of this one! All you need to do is follow me! To wherever I may roam!
lines.zh: : 答案可以是很多东西！但我对这一次的寻宝直觉非常强！你只要跟着我就好！无论我走到哪里！

lines.en: scene map2
: I think you’ve had enough, John.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你吃得够多了，John。

lines.en: : YOU...KNOW NOT...WHAT AWAITS YOU...
lines.zh: : 你们……不知道……等待你们的是什么……

lines.en: : I CAN TELL YOU...FOR A PRICE...
lines.zh: : 我可以告诉你们……以一个代价……

lines.en: : WORMS...PLACE THEM IN MY MOUTH...
lines.zh: : 虫子……把它们放进我的嘴里……

lines.en: : I WANT TO...FEEL THEM CRAWL...
lines.zh: : 我想……感觉它们爬动……

lines.en: scene black
: Drat! My insect supply has been reduced to ten minus ten!
lines.zh: : 可恶！我的昆虫储备已经减少到十减十了！

lines.en: : I am sorry, John! But there is a chance our treasure will contain more of your favorite snack if it is buried underneath the ground! Please wait patiently at house!
lines.zh: : 对不起，John！不过如果宝藏埋在地底下，说不定里面会有更多你最爱的零食！请在家里耐心等着！

lines.en: Kaori and I exit “house” as she tucks the map into her back pocket, but I’m unable to comment on how ridiculous this is on account of my mind getting caught up on an animal roughly twice my size instead.
lines.zh: Kaori 把地图塞进后口袋，我们走出了「家」，可我没法评价这一切有多荒唐，因为我的思绪全被一只差不多有我两倍大的动物绊住了。

lines.en: I’m sure it doesn’t do me any good worrying about such a thing when it’s clear there are some...oddities in this world to begin with.
lines.zh: 反正这个世界本来就有些……怪异之处，我操心这种事大概也没什么好处。

lines.en: But I wonder at what point they started becoming “oddities” in the first place?
lines.zh: 可我在想，它们到底是从什么时候开始变成「怪异」的？

lines.en: I wonder if there was ever a time without giant chickens or recycled worlds. When men roamed the streets freely and fewer girls felt inclined to spread their legs for me.
lines.zh: 我在想，是否曾经有过一个没有巨型鸡、也没有循环世界的时代。那时候男人可以自由地在街上闲逛，愿意为我张开腿的女孩也没那么多。

lines.en: I’m glad that {i}this{/i} is where I live, though. And that being detached from reality has become what’s truly “real” to me.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴自己住在{i}这里{/i}。也很高兴「脱离现实」已经成了对我来说真正「真实」的东西。

lines.en: scene map6

But then again, there are moments like this where I’m being dragged through a forest...that I really {i}do{/i} wish I was back in bed at home, with a niece who sees me as an {i}uncle{/i} just one room over.
lines.zh: 可话又说回来，像现在这样被人拖着穿过森林的时候……我真希望自己正躺在家里的床上，隔壁房间就住着那个把我当{i}叔叔{/i}看的侄女。

lines.en: This ridiculous world is fine when it favors me, but it is Hell when it doesn’t.
lines.zh: 这个荒唐的世界在眷顾我的时候还不错，可一旦不眷顾我，它就是地狱。

lines.en: And in this case, Hell is filled with the steam of a natural hot spring and a girl who should not be allowed outside of the house alone.
lines.zh: 而这一次，地狱里满是天然温泉的蒸汽，还有一个根本不该被允许独自出门的女孩。

lines.en: : Kaori...we’ve been wandering through the woods for an hour now. Are you sure whatever you’re looking for is {i}here?{/i}
lines.zh: : Kaori……我们已经在林子里转了一个小时了。你确定你要找的东西在{i}这儿{/i}吗？

lines.en: : We are getting close, Friend. The map tells me so.
lines.zh: : 我们快到了，朋友。地图是这么告诉我的。

lines.en: : You’ve been saying that this whole time. Also, the map can’t tell you anything. It is a map.
lines.zh: : 你从头到尾都在说这句。再说，地图可不会告诉你任何事。它就是张地图。

lines.en: : Is the purpose of a map not to direct the human or human equivalent that holds it?
lines.zh: : 地图的用途，不就是给拿着它的人类 —— 或者人类等价物 —— 指路吗？

lines.en: : It...{i}is.{/i} But definitely not in the way you’re making it sound.
lines.zh: : 是……{i}是{/i}的。但绝对不是你说的那种方式。

lines.en: scene map7
: Cheer up, duck that is made of rubber! If you are worried that the forest will swallow you, I can keep your human mind at ease with a fun game!
lines.zh: : 振作点，橡胶做的小鸭子！如果你担心森林会把你吞掉，我可以玩个有趣的游戏，让你的人类大脑放松下来！

lines.en: : What kind of {i}game{/i} can we play in the middle of the woods? Because the only one I can think of is one I’m almost certain you are not mentally mature enough to play yet.
lines.zh: : 在林子中间我们能玩什么{i}游戏{/i}？因为我唯一能想到的那个，我几乎可以肯定你心理上还不够成熟，玩不了。

lines.en: : An information game!
lines.zh: : 情报游戏！

lines.en: scene map8
: Anything you want to know, I will tell you! And then you will tell me a thing {i}you{/i} know!
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么，我就告诉你！然后你也告诉我一件{i}你{/i}知道的事！

lines.en: : I read in the friendship book that sharing stories with someone is the best way to make them love you! And there is no one who loves me, so such a thing sounds like it would be good and necessary!
lines.zh: : 我在友谊书里读到，和别人分享故事是让他们爱上你的最好方法！而根本没有人爱我，所以这件事听起来既美好又必要！

lines.en: : I’m sure Yuki-
lines.zh: : 我相信 Yuki——

lines.en: scene map9
: That is a different form of love.
lines.zh: : 那是另一种形式的爱。

lines.en: : The one I speak of is violent and passionate and would inflict a great deal of harm to both of us. But it would be a welcome instance of pain and suffering we would not trade for the world.
lines.zh: : 我说的那种爱，是暴烈的、炽热的，会给我们双方都造成巨大的伤害。但那会是一种我们甘愿承受的痛苦与折磨，拿全世界来换都不换。

lines.en: : It...what?
lines.zh: : 它……什么？

lines.en: scene map10
: Kaori...we’ve been wandering through the woods for an hour now. Are you sure whatever you’re looking for is-
lines.zh: : Kaori……我们已经在林子里转了一个小时了。你确定你要找的东西在——

lines.en: scene map11
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : We are getting close, Friend. The map tells me so.
lines.zh: : 我们快到了，朋友。地图是这么告诉我的。

lines.en: : Friend?
lines.zh: : 朋友？

lines.en: scene map12
: You’ve been saying that this whole time. Also, the map can’t tell you anything. It is a map.
lines.zh: : 你从头到尾都在说这句。再说，地图可不会告诉你任何事。它就是张地图。

lines.en: : Is the purpose of a map not to direct the human or human equivalent that holds it?
lines.zh: : 地图的用途，不就是给拿着它的人类 —— 或者人类等价物 —— 指路吗？

lines.en: : It...{i}is.{/i} But definitely not in the way you’re making it sound.
lines.zh: : 是……{i}是{/i}的。但绝对不是你说的那种方式。

lines.en: scene map13
: Cheer up, duck that is made of rubber! If you are worried that the forest will swallow you, I can keep your human mind at ease with a fun game!
lines.zh: : 振作点，橡胶做的小鸭子！如果你担心森林会把你吞掉，我可以玩个有趣的游戏，让你的人类大脑放松下来！

lines.en: : What kind of {i}game{/i} can we play in the middle of the woods? Because the only one I can think of is one I’m almost certain you are not mentally mature enough to play yet.
lines.zh: : 在林子中间我们能玩什么{i}游戏{/i}？因为我唯一能想到的那个，我几乎可以肯定你心理上还不够成熟，玩不了。

lines.en: : An information game!
lines.zh: : 情报游戏！

lines.en: scene map8
: Anything you want to know, I will tell you! And then you will tell me a thing {i}you{/i} know!
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么，我就告诉你！然后你也告诉我一件{i}你{/i}知道的事！

lines.en: : I read in the friendship book that sharing stories with someone is the best way to make them love you! And there is no one who loves me, so such a thing sounds like it would be good and necessary!
lines.zh: : 我在友谊书里读到，和别人分享故事是让他们爱上你的最好方法！而根本没有人爱我，所以这件事听起来既美好又必要！

lines.en: : I’m sure Yuki-
lines.zh: : 我相信 Yuki——

lines.en: scene map9
: That is a different form of love.
lines.zh: : 那是另一种形式的爱。

lines.en: : The one I speak of is much harder to comprehend.
lines.zh: : 我说的那种，要难懂得多。

lines.en: : It hurts. But it feels so good.
lines.zh: : 它会痛。但又感觉那么好。

lines.en: : It’s terrible. But it’s also wonderful.
lines.zh: : 它很可怕。可它又很美妙。

lines.en: : ...Kaori?
lines.zh: : ……Kaori？

lines.en: scene map14
: What is it, Friend? We are getting close. The map tells me so.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，朋友？我们快到了。地图是这么告诉我的。

lines.en: : Are you...starting to feel a little...strange in here?
lines.zh: : 你……是不是开始觉得……这里有点奇怪？

lines.en: scene map15
: Strange?
lines.zh: : 奇怪？

lines.en: : My leg-hands are warm from the water and my hair feels very zzzzzzz from the moist air, but I am still Kaori despite those small things.
lines.zh: : 我的腿手被水泡得暖暖的，潮湿的空气让我的头发感觉非常 zzzzzzz，但除了这些小事，我还是 Kaori。

lines.en: scene map16
: Oh! Light bulb!
lines.zh: : 哦！灯泡！

lines.en: : Maybe you would feel better if we played a game?
lines.zh: : 也许我们玩个游戏，你会感觉好一点？

lines.en: : What kind of {i}game{/i} can we play in the middle of the woods? Because the only one I can think of is one I’m almost certain you are not mentally mature enough to play yet.
lines.zh: : 在林子中间我们能玩什么{i}游戏{/i}？因为我唯一能想到的那个，我几乎可以肯定你心理上还不够成熟，玩不了。

lines.en: : An information game!
lines.zh: : 情报游戏！

lines.en: scene map17
: Anything you want to know, I will tell you! And then you will tell me a thing {i}you{/i} know!
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么，我就告诉你！然后你也告诉我一件{i}你{/i}知道的事！

lines.en: : I read in the friendship book that sharing stories with someone is the best way to make them love you! And there is no one who loves me, so such a thing sounds like it would be good and necessary!
lines.zh: : 我在友谊书里读到，和别人分享故事是让他们爱上你的最好方法！而根本没有人爱我，所以这件事听起来既美好又必要！

lines.en: : I’m sure Yuki-
lines.zh: : 我相信 Yuki——

lines.en: : Did you ever have someone you loved, Friend?
lines.zh: : 你曾经有过深爱的人吗，朋友？

lines.en: scene map18
: Did you?
lines.zh: : 你有吗？

lines.en: : If this “game” of yours is going to lead to questions like that, I’d probably prefer if we killed time with something else instead.
lines.zh: : 如果你这个「游戏」会问出这种问题，我可能更想用别的方式打发时间。

lines.en: : Killing is bad, Friend. All life must be treasured.
lines.zh: : 杀戮是不好的，朋友。一切生命都必须被珍视。

lines.en: : If it weren’t for those who valued life, you’d have never met the Queen of Spiders in the first place.
lines.zh: : 如果不是有人珍视生命，你一开始就不会遇到蜘蛛女王。

lines.en: scene map19
: It was just a phrase, Kaori. I don’t really disagree with any of that. And I’m glad you’re here.
lines.zh: : 那只是个说法而已，Kaori。我其实并不反对这些。而且我很高兴你在这里。

lines.en: : Would it increase your gladness if you were to ask me a reverse-answer before you must reverse-question any of mine?
lines.zh: : 如果在你反向问我之前，我可以先给你一个反向回答，你的高兴程度会不会提升？

lines.en: : Maybe, if I could actually think of something to ask you.
lines.zh: : 也许吧，如果我真能想出要问你什么的话。

lines.en: : Anything you want to know, I will tell you.
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么，我就告诉你。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Since we’re already on the topic, what was it like essentially...coming back from the dead?
lines.zh: : 既然都聊到这儿了，那……从死里复活，基本上是什么感觉？

lines.en: scene map20
: Very, very not good! No amount of grape-blood in see-through cylinders can compare to experiencing human life for the second first time!
lines.zh: : 非常、非常不好！再多的透明管子里的葡萄血，也比不上第二次第一次体验人类生命的感觉！

lines.en: scene map21
: I do not see it as returning from the unalived, though. I am remembered by Aunt Yukiburger and the slightly smaller, large-chested version of her that accompanies her into buildings sometimes.
lines.zh: : 不过我并不觉得那是从「未活」里归来。Yuki 堡阿姨还记得我，那个偶尔陪她进楼里的、稍微小一号但胸部很大的她也记得我。

lines.en: : And while these earlier memories have been ripped from my mind like coconuts off of a coconut tree, I can still feel my chest-muscle tighten each time my vision-balls connect with them.
lines.zh: : 虽然这些早期的记忆像椰子从椰子树上被摘下来一样、从我的脑子里被扯掉了，但每次我的眼球与她们相接，我还是能感觉到我的胸肌在收紧。

lines.en: : Is that strange, Friend? Am I mistaken in believing those feelings would not exist if I had truly left this place?
lines.zh: : 这很奇怪吗，朋友？如果我真的离开了这里，那些感觉就不会存在 —— 我这么想是错的吗？

lines.en: : As someone who has {i}probably{/i} never died before, I have no idea. I have heard of people with amnesia experiencing memories like that to some-
lines.zh: : 作为一个{i}大概{/i}从没死过的人，我不知道。我听说过失忆的人会以某种——

lines.en: scene map22
: ...extent.
lines.zh: : ……程度体验到这样的记忆。

lines.en: : Cheer up, duck that is made of rubber! If you are worried that the forest will swallow you, I can keep your human mind at ease with a fun game!
lines.zh: : 振作点，橡胶做的小鸭子！如果你担心森林会把你吞掉，我可以玩个有趣的游戏，让你的人类大脑放松下来！

lines.en: : Anything you want to know, I will tell you! And then you will tell me a thing {i}you{/i} know!
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么，我就告诉你！然后你也告诉我一件{i}你{/i}知道的事！

lines.en: : What do you want to know, Friend?
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么，朋友？

lines.en: : What is happening right now?
lines.zh: : 现在在发生什么？

lines.en: : Something is waking up.
lines.zh: : 有什么东西正在醒来。

lines.en: : Now, it is my turn to ask you a question.
lines.zh: : 现在，轮到我问你一个问题了。

lines.en: : What did you want to be when you were little?
lines.zh: : 你小时候想成为什么？

lines.en: : I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我不……

lines.en: scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy1
scene happy2
scene map23
: We are getting close, Friend. The map tells me so.
lines.zh: : 我们快到了，朋友。地图是这么告诉我的。

lines.en: : Let me see it.
lines.zh: : 让我看看。

lines.en: scene map24
: I want to find the treasure just as much as you, Friend! John needs more bugs and I enjoy taking things out of the ground!
lines.zh: : 我和你一样想找到宝藏，朋友！John 需要更多虫子，而我喜欢把东西从地里挖出来！

lines.en: : Do you doubt my ability to decipher text when it coats the body of a fallen tree? Is it because we are {i}surrounded{/i} by trees? Do you believe they are manipulating the text with their tree minds?
lines.zh: : 你是怀疑我解读附在倒树尸体上的文字的能力吗？是因为我们被树{i}包围{/i}了吗？你相信它们在用它们的树脑操纵那些文字吗？

lines.en: : I would not doubt it if they were. They are alive, you know. Maybe the reason we have not found it yet is because of their interference?
lines.zh: : 如果它们真在做，我一点也不怀疑。它们是活着的，你知道吧。也许我们还没找到，就是因为它们从中作梗？

lines.en: : Or maybe it’s because you just can’t read. Let me see it.
lines.zh: : 或者也许是因为你根本看不懂。让我看看。

lines.en: scene black
scene map25
: What are your thoughts, Friend? Are we as near to the marking as I believe we are?
lines.zh: : 你怎么想，朋友？我们是不是像我相信的那样，已经靠近那个标记了？

lines.en: I stare down at the “map” in Kaori’s hands and question why I followed her all the way out here without taking a look at it in the first place.
lines.zh: 我低头盯着 Kaori 手里的那张「地图」，开始怀疑自己为什么一路跟到这儿来，却压根没先看一眼它。

lines.en: This is all a joke, right?
lines.zh: 这一切都是个玩笑，对吧？

lines.en: She has an overactive imagination and just came up with some kind of...make-believe treasure hunt so we’d have something to do tonight.
lines.zh: 她想象力过于丰富，就编出了某种……假想的寻宝游戏，好让我们今晚有事可做。

lines.en: There was never anything to find. And that’s why she didn’t want me to see it earlier. She knew I would catch on and decide against coming with her.
lines.zh: 根本就没有什么可找的。所以她之前才不想让我看。她知道我会识破，然后决定不跟她来。

lines.en: Now, my ankles are drenched and my neck is covered in blood from the fifty or so mosquitos I’ve needed to slaughter while venturing through these woods.
lines.zh: 现在，我的脚踝湿透了，脖子上全是血 —— 那是我在林子里穿行时不得不拍死的大约五十只蚊子的血。

lines.en: And, on top of that, I think I’ve even begun to hallucinate from overexhaustion or something.
lines.zh: 而且，除此之外，我觉得自己甚至因为过度疲劳之类的原因开始产生幻觉了。

lines.en: I want to get out of here.
lines.zh: 我想离开这儿。

lines.en: I want this fake treasure hunt to come to an end.
lines.zh: 我想让这场假寻宝赶紧结束。

lines.en: : Kaori...let’s go home.
lines.zh: : Kaori……我们回家吧。

lines.en: : What?! But we are so close! Probably! Quitting now would mean walking away from something amazing!
lines.zh: : 什么？！可我们这么近了！大概吧！现在放弃，就意味着要远离某样了不起的东西！

lines.en: : How are you sure it’s so amazing? It’s one character on a sheet of paper you probably taped to your door yourself. It’s-
lines.zh: : 你怎么确定它有多了不起？那只是一张纸上的一个字，说不定还是你自己贴在门上的。它——

lines.en: scene map26
: No! There is an amazing treasure here! I am sure of it! We can not give up now! We must believe in ourselves! Personal pizza, Friend! Personal pizza!
lines.zh: : 不！这里真的有了不起的宝藏！我敢肯定！我们现在不能放弃！我们必须相信自己！单人披萨，朋友！单人披萨！

lines.en: : Kaori, give it a rest. Please.
lines.zh: : Kaori，别闹了。求你了。

lines.en: : There’s nothing here. I’m tired.
lines.zh: : 这里什么都没有。我累了。

lines.en: : Was I...wrong?
lines.zh: : 难道我……错了？

lines.en: : No...No, I know this is the right place! I can feel it!
lines.zh: : 不……不，我知道这就是正确的地方！我能感觉到！

lines.en: : Then we can...come back or something. But I’m leaving with or without you right now.
lines.zh: : 那我们可以……改天再来什么的。但我现在就要走，不管你跟不跟。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be here anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不想再待在这儿了。

lines.en: scene map27
: Hah...
: Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : I can not call myself a worthy companion if I repeatedly ask you to do things that make you unhappy.
lines.zh: : 如果我反复要求你做让你不开心的事，我就称不上一个合格的伴侣。

lines.en: : I am sorry, Friend. Please forgive me and do not leave me the way everyone else always does.
lines.zh: : 对不起，朋友。请原谅我，别像其他人那样丢下我。

lines.en: : I’m not going to {i}leave{/i} you. I just want to get out of the...place where the trees live and go to sleep.
lines.zh: : 我不会{i}丢下{/i}你的。我只是想离开这个……树住的地方，然后去睡觉。

lines.en: scene map28
: One more reading! Tell me your secrets, tree corpse! And do not interfere, natural wooden pillars!
lines.zh: : 再读一次！把你的秘密告诉我，树的尸体！还有，别来捣乱，天然的木头柱子们！

lines.en: : Kaori, come on.
lines.zh: : Kaori，走了。

lines.en: scene map29
: Ahhh! Fine!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！好吧！

lines.en: : But I am very reverse-happy about this!
lines.zh: : 但我对此非常反向高兴！

lines.en: scene black
